implementationSummary: Implemented password reset flow with secure tokens, email delivery, expiration, validation and password update.
requirement: User can reset a forgotten password using their registered email address.

steps: Send a password reset request using the registered email.
tests.rationale: Verifies the primary password reset request flow.
tests.expectedResult: The request succeeds and a password reset email is generated.
tests.title: Request password reset with registered email

preconditions: A reset token older than 30 minutes exists.
tests.rationale: Verifies token expiration and failure handling.
tests.expectedResult: The server rejects the token and does not change the password.
tests.title: Reject expired password reset token

acceptanceCriteria: AC-001: User can request a password reset.
AC-002: Registered users receive a reset email.
AC-003: Reset links expire after 30 minutes.
AC-004: User can set a valid new password.
AC-005: Invalid or expired tokens are rejected.
AC-006: Unknown emails receive a generic response.
AC-007: User can log in with the new password.
